title: Technology Sector Update for 11/21/2018: IQ,ABIL,ADSK,ESL,GOOG,GOOGL
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +1.63%
AAPL -0.05%
IBM +1.39%
CSCO +1.07%
GOOG +1.34%
Technology stocks firmed in late trading today, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding almost 0.9% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising more than 0.6%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) iQIYI ( IQ ) climbed over 8% on Wednesday after the Chinese online entertainment platform said it was teaming up with Alphabet's (GOOG,GOOGL) Google unit to incorporate Google's Widevine digital rights management technology into the Multi-DRM system of iQIYI's online video platform. iQIYI said the Widevine encryption system will enhance protection of licensed content played through its platform or other types of consumer devices.
In other sector news:
(+) Ability ( ABIL ) more than doubled in share price on Wednesday, rising as much as 135%, after it acquired the privately held developer of its Ultimate Interception cellular interception system for about $1 million in stock. Under terms of the proposed transaction, Ability will issue 354,609 shares of its common stock - equal to $1 million, based on Tuesday's closing price of $2.82 a share -along with warrants to buy up to 300,000 additional shares at $3.81 each.
(+) Autodesk ( ADSK ) pushed out to a 13% gain at one point during Wednesday trading after the software firm late Tuesday announced the planned $875 million buyout of PlanGrid, a construction productivity software developer. The deal is slated to close during the first three months of 2019.
(+) Esterline Technologies ( ESL ) was fractionally higher in recent trading after the defense and aerospace components manufacturer reported non-GAAP Q4 net income of $1.87 per share, up from $1.10 per share during the year-ago period and beating the Capital IQ consenus by $0.43 per share, of $1.44 per share on Capital IQ. Revenue rose to $535.3 million from $528.7 million last year and inching past the Street view expecting $534 million.
